idea-plugin.name: Open In Codex
idea-plugin.description:
Open In Codex starts a new Codex desktop session directly from IntelliJ IDEA.

Use it when you want Codex to inspect the project you are working on, or jump straight to the current file and line range from the editor.

  • Open File In Codex: opens a new Codex session with the current project path, current file path, and selected line range. If no text is selected, the current caret line is used.
  • Copy File Prompt: copies the current file path and selected line range to the clipboard without opening Codex.
  • Open Project In Codex: opens a new Codex session with the current project path as the Codex working directory.

Available entry points:

  • Tools menu: Tools | Open File In Codex and Tools | Open Project In Codex
  • Editor context menu: Open File In Codex and Copy File Prompt
  • Project view context menu: Open File In Codex, Copy File Prompt, and Open Project In Codex
  • Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+O for the current file, Alt+Shift+P for the current project

The plugin opens the Codex desktop protocol with prompts such as:

Project: D:\path\to\project
File: D:\path\to\File.java
Line: 24-27

Source code: https://github.com/Like-jian/idea-open-in-codex. If this plugin helps you, please consider giving the project a star on GitHub.
